reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Identified pte_none_or_zero() as a redundant function and suggested replacing it with a more descriptive helper like pte_is_zero_page().

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This RFC patch proposes adding a new helper function, pte_none_or_zero(), to the Linux kernel's mm module. The function is intended to simplify code that needs to check if a page table entry (PTE) maps nothing or the shared zeropage. It does this by checking if the PTE is either none or present and mapping the shared zeropage.

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau
reviews.summary: Agreed to drop pte_none_or_zero() and add a new helper function, pte_is_zero_page(), as suggested by David.
reviews.raw_body:
On Mon, Aug 17, 2026 at 07:57:29PM +0200, David Hildenbrand (Arm) wrote:
> And let the callers still spell both cases out.
> 
> if (pte_none(pte) || pte_is_zero_page(pte))
> 	/* Do something amazing */

Works for me.  I will drop pte_none_or_zero() and add pte_is_zero_page(),
which lines up with is_zero_page() in mm.h.

-- 
  Kiryl Shutsemau / Kirill A. Shutemov
